title: Comparing with the Last Snapshot
objective: Commit a README, edit it without staging, and print the name of the file the diff reports.
hint: Set-Location, git init -q -b main, then Set-Content for README.md, git add, and git commit -q -m "Add practice notes". Then Add-Content for Second section, and Write-Output with (git diff --name-only). Do not stage the edit.
